limitations: Before/after GPU timing uses identical HDF5 inputs, ABBA order and independent numerical gates.
CPU versus GPU ratios include differing stopping norms; both satisfy independent true-residual gates.
Host-idle checks are operational observations, not a hardware reservation or continuous load trace.
Memory admission is a conservative estimate, not a measured allocator peak or a 10 GB solve certificate.
